My research develops, evaluates, and implements statistical methods for psychology and the behavioral sciences. A large part of it asks when and why modeling approaches succeed or fail: I derive the conditions under which methods work, test them in simulation studies, and translate the results into practical recommendations and open-source software.

My current projects span several areas:

::: {.callout-note}
## 📊 Longitudinal, Multilevel, and Latent Variable Modeling
- Discrete- and continuous-time modeling of dynamic processes (CT-SEM, DSEM)  
- (Nonlinear) structural equation modeling (SEM)  
- Generalized linear mixed-effects models and hierarchical data analysis  
- Nonparametric estimation with and without measurement error  
- Multivariate modeling of long memory in time series  
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## 🔍 Power Analysis, Study Planning, and Model Evaluation
- Simulation-based power analysis and sample size planning for complex designs (e.g., longitudinal and multilevel studies)  
- Model fit and model selection  
- Model and distributional assumptions and the impact of misspecification  
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## 🧩 Causality, Heterogeneity, and Psychometrics
- Causal inference in longitudinal data (e.g., RI-CLPM, dynamic panel models)  
- Modeling and controlling for confounding  
- Parameter heterogeneity and measurement invariance (IPC regression, MNLFA)  
- (Psychometric) network analysis  
- Selection effects  
- Meta-analysis (meta-SEM, heterogeneity in effect sizes)  
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## 🤖 Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Software Development
- Adaptive algorithms and automation using machine learning  
- Nonlinear effects and machine learning for causal inference  
- Agentic AI for automating research tasks (e.g., designing, running, and documenting simulation studies)  
- Transparent and auditable AI research workflows (e.g., source-anchored literature work, AI-assisted coding with a human in the loop)  
- Generative AI in research, teaching, and statistical consulting  
- `R` package development and open-source software  
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## 🌐 Applications and Broader Interests
- Stress at work and emotional labor strategies (deep acting, surface acting) in the framework of job demands and resources  
- Mental health and well-being, including the prediction of treatment outcomes  
- Applications of statistical modeling and methods in:  
  - Psychology  
  - Medicine and neuroimaging  
  - Biology  
  - Epidemiology  
  - Educational research  
  - Econometrics  
:::
